changes_under_test: Principal-approved, exact-address agent registration prevents unauthorized Sybil addresses from consuming agent slots; pending approval slots are bounded and cancelable.
Owner-controlled admission bounds principal identities to 16.
Per-principal limits bound active agents to 8 and active policies to 4.
Expired proposal slots can be reclaimed without resetting the agent nonce.
Revoked or expired policies can be reclaimed after dependent agents and actions are cleared.
Consumer allowlist slots are recycled on consumer revocation.
Policy-instance generations prevent action-ID reuse after policy reclamation and recreation.
Policy-wide spend state uses bounded policy-instance/version buckets.
Aggregate quota does not reset if consensus time moves to an earlier bucket; it fails closed.

current_source_correction.finding: An arbitrary sender could self-register under any admitted principal and consume its bounded agent slots without that principal approving the address.
current_source_correction.mitigation: Admitted principals approve exact agent addresses; pending approvals reserve bounded per-principal and global capacity; approved addresses self-register; principal or contract owner can cancel pending approvals.
